# `company.prepayment_draws`

Each Customer Prepayment credit memo line: the receipt it draws from and the invoice or refund it went to.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this draw. |
| `credit_memo_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with credit_memo_id + line_id | — | transactions.id | Credit memo whose Customer Prepayment line draws the money. |
| `line_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with credit_memo_id + line_id | — | — | Stable identity of that credit memo line; its amount in the memo's current revision is the amount drawn. |
| `receipt_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_prepayment_draws_receipt | transactions.id | Sales receipt the money is drawn from. |
| `work_document_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | ix_prepayment_draws_document | work_documents.id | Customer-work document the money was held on when drawn; null when it was held for the customer. |
| `invoice_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | ix_prepayment_draws_invoice | transactions.id | Invoice the draw paid; null when it was refunded. |
| `refund_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | transactions.id | Customer refund that paid the draw back; null when it paid an invoice. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp the draw was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal that recorded the draw. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface the draw came through. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed the draw. |
